name.ara: قَصِيدَةٌ دَالِيَّةٌ فِي مَدْحِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
name.en: Dāliyya fī Madḥ al-Nabī - A Dāliyya in Praise of the Prophet ﷺ

ara: يَا سَيِّدِي، يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، يَا سَنَدِي
يَا مَنْ هُوَ الْمُرْتَجَى فِي كُلِّ نَازِلَةٍ
وَمَنْ هُوَ الْمَوْرِدُ الْأَحْلَى لِكُلِّ صَدِي
تُعْطِي الْجَزِيلَ بِلَا حَصْرٍ، وَلَا عَدَدِ
كَمْ شِدَّةٍ أَنْتَ كَافِيهَا، وَكَمْ مِحَنٍ
كُلَّ الْأَنَامِ، وَمَا ضَاقَتْ عَلَى أَحَدِ
فَاجْبُرْ بِهِ خَاطِرِي، وَاشْدُدْ بِهِ عَضُدِي
يَا أَكْرَمَ الْخَلْقِ، أَدْرِكْنِي، وَخُذْ بِيَدِي
إِذَا نَظَرْتَ إِلَيْهَا الْيَوْمَ لَمْ تَعُدِ
وَضَاعَفَتْ وَقْعَ مَا أَلْقَاهُ مِنْ كَبَدِ
وَلَا أَفِيءُ إِلَى صَبْرٍ، وَلَا جَلَدِ
مَا لِي أَخَافُ الرَّدَى فِي ظِلِّ سَاحَتِكُمْ
ضَيْمٌ، وَأُصْبِحُ فِي هَمٍّ، وَفِي نَكَدِ؟!
مِنْ أَيْنَ لِي مَوْرِدٌ أَسْقِي بِهِ ظَمَئِي
إِنْ كُنْتُ فِي بَحْرِكَ الْمَوْرُودِ لَمْ أَرِدِ؟!
إِنْ كُنْتُ عِنْدَكَ هَذَا الْعَطْفَ لَمْ أَجِدِ؟!
وَمَنْ يُقَوِّمُ لِي مَا فِيَّ مِنْ عِوَجٍ
إِنْ كُنْتَ لَمْ تَبْغِ تَقْوِيمِي، وَلَمْ تُرِدِ؟!
فَانْظُرْ إِلَيَّ بِعَيْنِ الْعَطْفِ، وَارْعَ حَشًا
بَاقٍ عَلَى الْعَهْدِ، لَمْ يَنْكُثْ، وَلَمْ يَحِدِ
فِي نَيْلِ عَطْفِكَ مِنْ أَهْلِي، وَمِنْ وَلَدِي
وَاهْزِمْ جُيُوشَ الْعِدَى مَهْمَا يَكُنْ لَهُمُ
مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْبَأْسِ، أَوْ مِنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَدَدِ
en: Yā sayyidī, yā Rasūla-llāhi, yā sanadī
yā wāsiʿa l-faḍli wa-l-iḥsāni wa-l-madadi
Yā man huwa l-murtajā fī kulli nāzilatin
wa-man huwa l-mawridu l-aḥlā li-kulli ṣadī
Yumnāka fawqa l-biḥāri z-zākhirāti nadan
tuʿṭī l-jazīla bi-lā ḥaṣrin wa-lā ʿadadi
Kam shiddatin anta kāfīhā, wa-kam miḥanin
ḥallat yamīnuka minhā sāʾira l-ʿuqadi
Abwābu sāḥatika l-fayḥāʾi qad wasiʿat
kulla l-anāmi, wa-mā ḍāqat ʿalā aḥadi
Waqaftu bi-l-bābi, yā mawlāya, lī amalun
fa-jbur bihi khāṭirī, wa-shdud bihi ʿaḍudī
Waqaftu bi-l-bābi arjū kashfa ḍāʾiqatī
yā akrama l-khalqi, adriknī, wa-khudh bi-yadī
Fī l-qalbi wa-l-jismi ālāmun tuʿāwidunī
idhā naẓarta ilayhā l-yawma lam taʿudi
Ṭālat ʿalayya, wa-qad ḍāqat masālikuhā
wa-ḍāʿafat waqʿa mā alqāhu min kabadi
Lā yastaṭīʿu lahā juhdī muqāwamatan
wa-lā afīʾu ilā ṣabrin wa-lā jaladi
Mā lī akhāfu r-radā fī ẓilli sāḥatikum
wa-hya l-amānu wa-mahdu l-ʿīshati r-raghadi
A-fī jiwārika, yā Maʾmūnu, yalḥaqunī
ḍaymun, wa-uṣbiḥu fī hammin wa-fī nakadi?!
A-ashtakī ḍ-ḍīqa wa-l-ḥirmāna fī baladin
fīhā ghiyāthu l-barāyā minḥatu ṣ-Ṣamadi?!
Fīhā l-ḥabību lladhī turjā shafāʿatuhu
wa-yustajāru bihi fī aʿẓami sh-shidadi
Kullu l-maṭālibi wa-l-ḥājāti in fuqidat
fa-innahā turtajā fī hādhihi l-baladi
Min ayna lī mawridun asqī bihi ẓamaʾī
in kuntu fī baḥrika l-mawrūdi lam aridi?!
Wa-ayna aḥẓā bi-ʿaṭfin shāmilin wa-riḍan
in kuntu ʿindaka hādhā l-ʿaṭfa lam ajidi?!
Wa-man yuqawwimu lī mā fiyya min ʿiwajin
in kunta lam tabghi taqwīmī wa-lam turidi?!
Wāfaytu muʿtaqidan anna l-masīra ilā
maghnāka fīhi ḥayātu r-rūḥi wa-l-jasadi
Fa-nẓur ilayya bi-ʿayni l-ʿaṭfi, wa-rʿa ḥashan
bāqin ʿalā l-ʿahdi, lam yankuth wa-lam yaḥidi
Wa-rʿa ṣaḥbī wa-aḥbābī wa-man ṭamiʿū
fī nayli ʿaṭfika min ahlī wa-min waladī
Wa-nẓur li-jayshika jayshi l-muslimīna taʿud
ilayhi haybatuhu fī sālifi l-amadi
Wa-hzim juyūsha l-ʿidā mahmā yakun lahumu
min shiddati l-baʾsi aw min kathrati l-ʿadadi
Dāmat ʿalayka ṣalātu-llāhi ʿāṭiratan
wa-dāma dhikruka marfūʿan ilā l-abadi
O my master, O Messenger of God, O my support,
O you whose bounty, beneficence and succour are vast.
O you who are hoped for in every calamity,
the sweetest spring for every thirsting soul.
Your right hand surpasses the brimming seas in generosity;
it gives abundantly, beyond limit or count.
How many hardships you have warded off, and how many trials
whose every knot your right hand has untied!
The doors of your spacious court have embraced all mankind,
and never grown narrow for anyone.
I have stood at the door, O my master, with a hope;
through it mend my broken heart and strengthen my arm.
I stood at the door hoping my distress would be lifted.
O most generous of creation, rescue me and take me by the hand.
In heart and body are pains that keep returning to me;
if you look upon them today, they will return no more.
They have lingered long upon me, their ways out grown narrow,
doubling the weight of the hardship I endure.
My strength cannot withstand them,
and I find no refuge in patience or endurance.
Why should I fear ruin in the shade of your court,
when it is safety itself and the cradle of an ample life?
In your neighbourhood, O Trustworthy One, shall injustice overtake me,
and shall I wake in worry and misery?!
Shall I complain of hardship and deprivation in a land
where dwells the succour of all creatures, the gift of the Eternal Refuge?!
In it is the Beloved whose intercession is hoped for,
in whom refuge is sought in the gravest hardships.
Every aim and need, if it could not be found or granted elsewhere,
may be hoped for in this city.
Where else would I find a spring to quench my thirst,
if I did not come to drink from your much-visited sea?!
And where would I be granted all-embracing kindness and good pleasure,
if I did not find this kindness with you?!
And who would straighten the crookedness within me,
if you did not seek to set me right, nor did you want it?!
I have come believing that the journey to your abode
holds life for soul and body alike.
So look upon me with the eye of kindness, and care for a heart
that stays true to its covenant; it has neither broken it nor swerved.
And care for my companions and loved ones,
and those of my family and children who long for your kindness.
And look upon your army, the army of the Muslims,
so its awe may return to it as in ages past.
And rout the armies of the foe,
however great their might or however many their numbers.
May God's fragrant blessings rest upon you always,
and may your mention stay exalted forever.
